feature: RSI step 2: reviewed project experience reuse

behavior.entry: 任务复盘 → 整理为经验
behavior.storage: .aistudio/agent/ immutable library snapshots and source review artifacts
behavior.adoption: explicit human review of applicability, keywords and advice; exact review evidence match
behavior.retrieval: offline explicit keyword matching; at most 3 entries and 12000 UTF-8 bytes; no same-task feedback
behavior.invalidation: disabled advice, changed source task revisions, missing provenance and corruption excluded; provider session renewed when selection changes
behavior.authority: advisory context only; tool schemas, project revisions and approvals retain authority
behavior.audit: context preparation and source snapshot references; not a claim of execution or effectiveness
